import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate multi-class classification dataset
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=300, n_features=8, n_informative=6, n_classes=4, random_state=42, n_redundant=2)

# Apply LDA to reduce to 3 components (max n_classes - 1)
lda = LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(n_components=3)
X_lda = lda.fit_transform(X, y)

# Print the explained variance ratio for each LDA component
print("LDA explained variance ratio:", lda.explained_variance_ratio_)
print("Cumulative:", np.cumsum(lda.explained_variance_ratio_))

# Create a dataframe with LDA components
df_lda = pd.DataFrame(X_lda, columns=[f'LD{i+1}' for i in range(X_lda.shape[1])])
df_lda['class'] = y

# Print the transformed data
print("\nLDA Transformed Data (first 10 rows):")
print(df_lda.head(10))
print("\nClass means on LD1:")
print(df_lda.groupby('class')['LD1'].mean().round(3))
